Verified at 250 dpi: Lines 1 and 2 print $400.00 and $890.20 in BOTH columns, byte-identical to the PRIOR year's year-end filing (key 4dffe4f6, 1/30/13), while Line 4 ('from Line 1 Column A') prints $23,050.00 and Line 6 ('from Line 2 Column A') prints $1,759.04. Lines 3-7 are internally consistent with each other ($8,337.51 + $23,050.00 = $31,387.51; less $1,759.04 = $29,628.47) and line 7 carries forward correctly to the April 2014 report. So the filer appears to have reused the 2012 form and updated only the balance block: lines 1/2 do NOT describe this reporting period. Everything recorded verbatim; nothing inferred or repaired.
